title: Insane Grain
summary: A bold snack packaging concept combining health-conscious positioning with rebellious typography, high-contrast color, and skater-inspired energy.
meta: Insane Grain packaging, Strikin’ Hot flavor packaging, graphic system, mockups

hero.alt: Insane Grain pouch: a halftone mouth, red chili and flame linework in red, black and white, with tall condensed type.

items.label: Project
items.text: Insane Grain is a conceptual snack packaging project designed to give a health-conscious product a louder, more unconventional personality. The visual identity combines youthful energy, skater-inspired references, and an intentionally chaotic aesthetic while maintaining a clear information hierarchy.

items.label: Creative direction
items.text: The packaging uses a red, black, and white palette to establish a bold visual presence. Expressive typography and energetic compositions challenge the restrained, wellness-focused conventions often associated with healthier snacks. The goal is to make the packaging feel rebellious and approachable without allowing its personality to overwhelm essential product information.

items.label: Design approach
items.text: The system balances visual disruption with practical communication. Strong typography, contrasting colors, and expressive graphic elements create shelf presence, while a deliberate hierarchy keeps the product identity and supporting information legible. The related Strikin’ Hot variant extends the concept through a distinct flavor expression.

blocks.label: 01 — Research
blocks.heading: Borrowing from collage posters
blocks.body: I pulled collage portraits, halftone photography and loud poster typography: work that feels cut up, layered and a little unhinged, which is exactly what the name asks for.

blocks.heading: Two early directions
blocks.body: A digital collage tested how photography, halftone and flat colour could share one surface. A marker sketch blocked out the grid underneath it.
